rationale_detailed.key_strengths: Candidate has longevity in the VA/EA space with approximately 8+ years of combined experience since 2014. Shows breadth of skills including calendar management, email organization, travel arrangements, and customer support. Familiar with a wide range of tools including project management (Trello, Asana), CRM (Salesforce, Zoho), marketing automation (ActiveCampaign, Mailchimp, ClickFunnels), and e-commerce platforms (Shopify). Has experience with social media management and content creation. Claims testimonials from clients which suggests some level of client satisfaction.
rationale_detailed.key_gaps: CRITICAL: Experience threshold failed (9.0 vs 10.0 required). The EA experience is primarily freelance/contract work without clear organizational integration - no named companies or executives supported in the 2016-present period. Early career (2014-2016) was customer service at Chase Bank and Amazon - these are Tier C companies for EA purposes and were CSR roles, not true EA roles. Misamis University is not a top-tier Philippine institution (Tier 2 at best). No honors mentioned. Degree in Social Work Management has limited relevance to EA role. No evidence of strategic EA work or thought partnership - descriptions are transactional and task-focused. No quantified business impact or measurable results mentioned. No references with actual contact information provided. Age and life circumstances unknown. No awards, certifications, or evidence of self-motivated learning mentioned. Resume design is functional but not distinctive.
rationale_detailed.recommendation_reasoning: With a final score of 40.0 and 2/3 thresholds passed, this candidate falls into Tier 3 Below territory. While she passes Skills and Communication thresholds, she fails the critical Experience & Trajectory threshold. Her experience is primarily freelance VA work without evidence of supporting high-level executives in demanding environments. The lack of named companies, specific executives supported, or measurable outcomes in her current role (2016-present) is concerning. The early career in CSR at Chase and Amazon, while at known companies, was not EA work. This is a marginal candidate who should only be considered if stronger candidates are unavailable.
rationale_detailed.interview_focus: If interviewed, probe deeply on: 1) Specific executives she has supported - names, titles, company sizes, and what made the work demanding; 2) Examples of strategic projects where she demonstrated judgment and ownership beyond task execution; 3) Quantifiable business impact from her work - time saved, processes improved, problems solved; 4) Why she has remained in freelance work rather than embedded roles - is this by choice or circumstance; 5) References who can speak to her EA capabilities in demanding environments.
